hypothesis: When the original Stage1 own-state dynamic risk cap cuts more nominal beta from the raw allocator target, holding cash should rank better than SOXX over the next five funded open-to-open intervals. A positive association is necessary but not sufficient for a useful controller.
parent: Frozen complete Stage1 f696 allocation, b472 action/risk/recovery, 0bp own-state Qlib path. No beta-composition candidate or bypass path is used to construct the score.
score: max(0, 3*raw Stage1 SOXL weight + raw Stage1 SOXX weight - same-date own-state current_beta_cap), computed from information available by 09:46; no threshold or normalization chosen from returns.
label: Existing fixed cash_advantage_h5 from the source Recorder: negative log SOXX return over five funded 09:47-to-next09:47 intervals, mature only after final exit. Keep four unmatured endpoint rows unknown.
scope: All 944 aligned signal/trade dates, exactly 940 mature H5 labels; report full history, each of 4 years including partial 2023/2026, all 16 quarters and all 819 contiguous 126-session windows. Compare 2024Q3 and 2026Q3 only as already selected descriptive controls.
primary_statistic: Spearman rank correlation of cap-gap score and mature cash_advantage_h5 across all 940 rows; expected sign positive. Also report existing frozen_current_cash_weight on the identical rows as a descriptive matched control, not a new selection criterion.

uncertainty.method: circular stationary bootstrap on the full 944-day calendar, preserving unknown label locations

decision: If point estimate is nonpositive or the descriptive lower interval is nonpositive, this necessary condition provides no support for cap-gap as a standalone cash-advantage signal. A positive result would only motivate a separately frozen original-39-input incremental test, not a cap switch or account.
stop: One statistic and one fixed interval only. No sign inversion, cash threshold, risk-cap change, label horizon/window change or conditional subset rescue. Reused history is development-only, and local correlation never substitutes for a 0bp Tiered-fee full account or v2 forward gates.
